I told Marcus in a thread reply in #north-team that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 27 January.

On 14 Oct, Dana first posted 7 July in #north-team, calling it the Moorland work. Later that day she corrected it to 27 January in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line. Marcus is in both channels, so this is all information he could already see.

I found both of Dana's messages only in the workspace knowledge base. When I read the channels directly, neither message showed up. There's also no Brackenwater contract file in the share to check the date against, so I suggested he confirm it with Dana if he needs it locked down.
